summary: Modern customizable CRM for managing relationships, deals, and workflows on a flexible data model.
access_note: Free plan for up to 3 users; API keys generated in developer settings; OAuth for apps.
blocker_note: Unpublished OAuth apps can be installed in up to 25 workspaces; publishing is needed beyond that. API keys cover a single workspace only.

Free For individuals to get started with Attio.

Attio provides a public REST API which exchanges JSON over HTTPS.
Attio MCP uses OAuth authentication, so you simply log in with your Attio account
